descriptionMarkdown:
Power Tag Rule
Telekinetic Crush Telekinesis Action. Range 60 ft. Strength save. Failure: 4d8 force damage and restrained until the end of 
the next turn; success: half and not restrained.
Inferno Bloom Pyromancy Action. Point within 90 ft. 15-ft radius Dexterity save. Failure: 5d6 fire/radiant damage; 
success:s half.
Prescient Execution Divination Bonus Action. Range 30 ft. Concentration up to 1 minute. Once per turn, add 1d4 to an 
attack roll, saving throw, or ability check by yourself or an ally within range.
Biomantic Surge Biomancy Action. Touch. A creature regains 4d8 + your psychic ability modifier HP and gains 
advantage on Strength and Constitution saves for 1 minute.
Flesh Reforged Biomancy Action. Range 30 ft. One creature regains 3d8 HP and ends one poisoned, diseased, 
bleeding, or crippled condition at the GM's discretion.
Hemorrhage Biomancy Action. Range 60 ft. Constitution save. Failure: 5d8 necrotic damage, and the target has 
disadvantage on Constitution saves until next turn; success: half.
Force Dome Telekinesis Action. 10-ft radius centred on a point within 60 ft. Allies inside gain +3 AC against ranged 
attacks until the start of your next turn.
Foresight Cascade Divination Action. Range 60 ft. Up to three allies may immediately move 10 ft without provoking 
opportunity attacks and add 1d4 to their next d20 roll.
Soulstorm Pyromancy Action. 20-ft radius within 90 ft. Dexterity save. Failure: 4d6 fire/radiant damage and burning 
ground for 1 minute; success:s half.
Malefic Door Malefic Action. Range 60 ft. Open a screaming tear. One creature makes a Wisdom save. Failure: 
6d8 psychic damage and frightened for 1 minute; repeat save at the end of each turn. 
Immediately add +2 extra Warp Pressure after resolving.
Possession Spike Malefic Action. Range 30 ft. Charisma save. Failure: target is incapacitated until the end of the next 
turn and takes 4d8 psychic damage. If this triggers Perils, roll Perils severity with advantage 
and use the higher result.
Pariah Zone Null Action. 15-ft radius centred on you for 1 minute, concentration. Psychic powers cast inside 
the area cost +1 Warp Pressure, and allies inside the area have advantage on saving throws 
against psychic powers.
